posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
There are resources that have been around forever, but quite a chunk have been lost due to sites going down.
Some of those are still accessible with the waybackmachine, but to find them, you have to know that they exist and you have to know the link.
Mack's Stuff is very well known, but the XP resources are mostly forgotten, probably since VX and Ace had the same tile setup and style and XP is considered very outdated by now. But nonetheless, there is some amazing stuff, and for everyone who still likes to use XP style things (with the MZ grid change option probably more likely than a year ago) or those who are okay with some editing, those are a gold mine.
The bear is something I see a lot around the internet with many not knowing where it is coming from, and besides it especially DS tileset users might be interested in the tiles.
For the terms, here is a google translated version of them:
～Special material for RPG Maker XP～ The material in this corner is an improved RTP material for RPG Maker XP, so it can only be used with RPG Maker XP. Also, if you are an XP regular user, you can redistribute the improved data of this material as XP exclusive material. However, please refrain from secondary distribution of unimproved materials as they are. ～Other Materials～ Due to image standards, it is clearly stated that it is for XP, 2000, etc., but it is a completely original material, so you can use it as a material for Maker, HP, or other tools. You can also use it in the form of materials for creating materials. The improved material can be redistributed as improved material. However, please refrain from distributing the materials for free and selling them in the form of material collections. There is no problem in distributing games that use materials for a fee. ~ About copyright notice ~ All materials on this site are created by the administrator MACK. When distributing games using materials, or when distributing processed materials, contact is not necessary, but as a copyright notice, please put a special thank you on the staff roll, read me documents, manuals, in the corner of the distribution site, etc. ●MACK●Looseleaf
http://www.mogunet.net/~mack/
Please write the copyright notice like this.
